description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for a chat application's empty state screen, including UI components like app bar, background gradient, noise overlay, and content layout for the empty chat screen.

classes.name: ChatEmptyStateScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the entire chat empty/landing screen, assembling background, top bar, illustration, and text components.

classes.name: ChatTopBar
classes.description: A widget mimicking an iOS style navigation bar with a back button, centered title, and menu button.

classes.name: _TopBarIconButton
classes.description: A helper widget for rendering icon buttons in the top bar with fixed size and semantics.

classes.name: ChatEmptyStateText
classes.description: Displays headline and supporting text in the center of the screen.

classes.name: _ChatBackgroundGradient
classes.description: Provides a gradient background for the chat empty screen.

classes.name: _NoiseOverlay
classes.description: A custom painter overlay that adds subtle noise/stars effect for visual texture.

classes.name: _NoisePainter
classes.description: Implements the drawing algorithm for the noise overlay pattern.

classes.name: _HeroRobotIllustration
classes.description: Displays an illustration asset or fallback placeholder of a friendly robot in the UI.

classes.name: _RobotPlaceholder
classes.description: Fallback widget displaying a stylized robot icon when the image asset is unavailable.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the ChatEmptyStateScreen widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the ChatTopBar widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the _TopBarIconButton widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the text block containing headline and supporting line.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates the noise overlay canvas painting pattern.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Draws a randomized scatter of small circles to create a noise texture.

methods.name: shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines if the noise painter needs to repaint when parameters change.

methods.name: _HeroRobotIllustration.build
methods.description: Displays the robot illustration asset or a placeholder if the asset isn't available.

methods.name: _RobotPlaceholder.build
methods.description: Provides a fallback visual icon representing the robot if the asset fails to load.
